title: Friendship
theme: Regular meetups, a new friend, a favor, drifting apart, a falling out and making up.

storylets.title: A friend with broth
storylets.note: Someone is sick at home, which the watcher can't see: the door just stays shut. Then a friend turns up with food, and the reason comes out on the step. Engine: a sick day is a routine change (the person stays home); this storylet only fires while it lasts.
